name: clinic-app
description: Clinic Management System — root helper scripts for the server + client workspaces

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run setup && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix server start
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
